text: @guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的界面增强插件，通过 Web 设置页和会话界面插槽提供外观与操作改进。它可分别调整正文和代码字体、适配手机布局、显示最近会话，并提供快捷操作、快速回复、上下文进度环和输出动效；还可自定义品牌图像与运行提示，并按需翻译插件和技能描述。字体文件由主机按需从镜像获取并缓存，用户可在 UI Beautify 设置中选择功能；安装需 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 或更新版本。

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify adds mobile layout, font choices, recent conversations, quick actions and replies, and a context ring to DSH Web. It supports custom branding and description translation. Fonts are fetched and cached on demand. Configure in UI Beautify settings; requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.1+.
想让 DSH 在手机上更容易浏览会话和设置。
我想在聊天页面换正文和代码字体。
能不能快速切回最近打开的几个会话？
希望在对话页面用按钮归档或固定当前会话。
给我一个点击就能发送常用短句的回复栏。
我想看上下文占用情况，不用打开统计面板。
I want the DSH web interface to work better on a phone.
Can I choose separate fonts for chat text and code?
I need quick access to my recently used conversations.
Can I archive or pin a conversation without opening the sidebar?
@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify 的功能「手机界面适配」：将侧栏导航改为手机端抽屉入口，并优化会话和设置区域布局。启用后可从页面按钮打开侧栏，最近会话功能可单独开关。
@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify 的功能「字体与外观」：为正文和代码分别选择字体，并设置品牌图像、名称和标语。主机按需获取字体文件并缓存，设置页管理这些选项。
@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify 的功能「最近会话」：在会话页展示按活动时间排序的最多五个会话。点击条目即可切换会话，空白草稿和已归档会话不会进入列表。
@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify 的功能「会话快捷操作」：在当前会话旁提供可拖动按钮，菜单可归档、固定或切换会话；操作通过 DSH Workspace 服务执行。
@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify 的功能「快速回复」：在输入区下方显示常用短句标签。点击标签会将短句写入草稿并提交，用户也可在设置中替换短句。
@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify 使用前须知：字体文件会由主机按需从 npmmirror 或 jsDelivr 获取，并保存在本机缓存目录。

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Background：A third-party interface enhancement plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/), focused on **mobile usability**: making conversations, the sidebar, and settings easier to use on small screens.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Background：It also offers independent body and code font choices, custom logos, icons, names and welcome taglines, and translation of English skill and plugin descriptions into the interface language using the default model. Other improvements include recent conversation tabs, upward navigation through your sent questions (which loads the older page once the loaded history runs out), a floating one-line preview of the round you are reading that jumps back to its start, a composer light beam, and desktop quick replies.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Background：Every choice on the settings page reports its own write: the row says it is saving, confirms when the value landed, and offers a retry when the Host refuses it. The name and tagline fields wait for an input method to finish before they commit, so confirming a candidate never saves half a word.

On phones whose browser predates the newest JavaScript APIs, the plugin completes the ones the PDF engine calls, so PDF and Word/PowerPoint previews open instead of failing with `... is not a function`.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Installation：Requires DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.1 or newer**. This example uses the `web` profile:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add @guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify
```

Restart the corresponding host and reload the browser, then open **Settings → UI Beautify**. Click **Translate descriptions** to generate translations; this uses the default model's quota, caches results, and leaves original files unchanged.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Installation：Translations sharing the same local data directory are deduplicated across host processes, including recovery after an owner exits. Unknown locks are preserved rather than deleted. Recovery retains small generation-marker directories to prevent stale processes from taking a newer lock; do not clean these markers while any host is running.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Version and upgrade：General settings gains one line under **Current version**: the newest release published to the desktop shell's own update feed, with an **Upgrade** button beside it. The button opens the shell's existing update flow, so downloading and installing stay with the updater that owns them; when the running install is already the newest release, the line says so and the button is disabled.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Version and upgrade：The line appears only where a feed exists. A desktop build carries `resources/app-update.yml` naming its feed URL and channel, which is what the row reads; a plain `dsh web` install has no such file and sees no row. A deployment that publishes elsewhere — an internal mirror, a different channel — names its manifest explicitly:

```yaml
- id: ui-beautify
  name: '@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify'
  config:
    updateFeedUrl: 'https://example.com/releases/latest.yml'

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Recent conversations：Recent conversations have their own switch in **Settings → UI Beautify** and do not require the code work view or mobile adaptation. The strip shows up to five eligible conversations in activity order; selecting one does not reorder it. Tabs use the host theme tokens in light and dark mode, including when the host has no conversation/trace tab bar.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Recent conversations：On desktop the strip is a hemp line pinned to the header's left and right edges. Up to five recent conversations hang from it on clothespins in the middle, the selected conversation is tinted, and the line sags toward the middle. The line shares the row with the host conversation/trace tabs, which stay clickable; the header grows by the line height. When the header narrows, the tags shrink and then move to their own row below the host tabs, and the line still reaches both edges. At widths of 600px or less, phones keep the previous text-tab strip and hide the host view tabs. A host-native recent strip takes precedence. Disabling recent conversations or unloading the plugin removes the strip and restores the host tabs.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Recent conversations：For development, `pnpm run test:recent` runs catalog/status tests and a real Chrome/React fixture at 1200, 601, 600 and 393px, including delayed tab bars, the band/stack fallbacks, session navigation and cleanup. It uses the existing desktop-profile Playwright installation and local Chrome; set `DSH_MOBILE_PLAYWRIGHT` and `DSH_MOBILE_CHROME` to use other installations. It does not launch or change a running DSH host.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Unread conversations：When a run finishes while you are viewing another conversation, the sidebar marks that conversation with a green dot. Opening it lands at the beginning of its latest answer instead of the bottom of the transcript, so the answer can be read from its first line. The landing waits for the host to restore the conversation, uses the same reading inset as the navigation controls, and backs off as soon as you scroll yourself. Its switch, **Unread conversation opens at the answer**, lives in **Settings → UI Beautify → Interface enhancements** and defaults on.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Floating quick actions：A draggable button floats at the bottom-right of an open conversation. Its position is kept in the browser, so it survives a reload, and the button rests just above the message box rather than over its send button; drag it anywhere inside the window. Clicking it opens a host menu with three shortcuts for the conversation on screen:

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Floating quick actions：Every action calls the same Workspace service the sidebar uses, so the sidebar, the green dot and this button always agree. Failures are reported inside the menu instead of silently disappearing. Its switch, **Floating quick actions**, lives in **Settings → UI Beautify → Interface enhancements** and defaults on.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Running indicator：While a reply streams, one line with an icon sits at the bottom of the conversation. **Settings → UI Beautify → Running indicator** replaces either half of it:

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Running indicator：Both halves are live: a row already streaming updates on its next repaint, with no restart or reload. The host rewrites that line every second for its clock, so the plugin reapplies the phrase after each rewrite.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Streamlined interface：**Settings → UI Beautify → Streamlined interface** removes the entries a deployment does not want its users to reach: it hides the settings header's **Open configuration file** action and the **Plugins** and **Agent presets** pages from the settings navigation, and moves the sidebar's **Plugins** and **Automation tasks** rows into the settings navigation, where each row opens the page it names. While **Coding Tools** are off in General settings, it also hides the Agent preset picker on the new-session page and the preset label beside the conversation title. The hidden settings pages and the relocated sidebar entries stay composed — only their rows move — and turning the switch off restores every host entry.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Streamlined interface：The same page hides the three readings below the message box with its own switch, **Hide the statistics under the message box**: the round/step count with output speed, the token spend with its cache-hit share, and the host's context meter. It is independent of the switch above, and turning it off brings all three readings back.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Streamlined interface：Two more switches in the same group empty the message box's bottom row: **Hide the model selector** and **Hide the access mode**. They are independent of each other and **default off**, so a fresh install keeps the host's model and access-mode controls; turning a row on hides only that host seat, and turning it off restores it. Both controls stay reachable through the host's own **/model** and **/permission** commands.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Streamlined interface：**Hide the sidebar logo and name** empties the sidebar's top-left corner: the mark — the host's own or an uploaded brand image — and the product name beside it both go, while retaining the sidebar toggle and **New Session** button. Desktop also collapses the empty brand row so New Session moves up without a blank brand placeholder; Web retains the top row carrying its sidebar toggle. Turning it off restores the host layout. It is independent of the other rows and **default off**, so the brand stays until someone turns it on.

@guowenzhang/dsh-ui-beautify README · Context progress ring：The message box's primary button — the same one that sends and interrupts — carries a thin progress ring around its edge that shows how much of the model's context window is in use. The reading comes from the host's own context-pressure projection and uses the same formula as the host's context meter, so the two never disagree; the ring follows the theme's business colour over a border-token track and sits outside the button, where it never takes clicks or changes the layout. It has its own switch in **Settings → UI Beautify → Interface enhancements** and is independent of the statistics switch: hiding the readings under the message box leaves the ring in place.
